received_works.body:
Hi Aono! I really love the last commission you did of Lea!! I stare at it all the time on my desktop. I want to request another one for her but in a new outfit.

I would like to request an illustration background in 16:9 aspect ratio, please. I was thinking the setting maybe somewhere in between these two references:
https://sta.sh/217h5ev7j8xv?edit=1

This illustration will be for my OC Lea:
https://sta.sh/2gk5xiyt2hi?edit=1

Please use this outfit:
https://sta.sh/01ib39irfuxu

Lea is my main protagonist who starts off as an optimistic, cheerful, and enthusiastic adventurer on a mission. For this illustration, I want to capture Lea as a mature, elegant, and grown-up lady. She accomplished her mission and gets to relax back at this nice place.

I would like to leave the pose, background, and expression to you. I trust your judgment and skills. Also, feel free to change her outfit or tweak it to your liking. I really want Lea to look gorgeous/beautiful.

Thank you for considering my request and may you have a great day!

https://sta.sh/2gk5xiyt2hi?edit=1

character: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1--WBkcwvD4rNb3F_-ND1UEsS2l3d7npR?usp=sharing

pose and background:
standing in the middle of a summoning circle with skulls,blood,corpses with an arrogant smile
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1vNL2kRgpE6RuX388p1jy2AFp-ERCIh-W/view?usp=sharing

Hello teacher, I saw your beautiful pictures on Twitter and I like your painting style very much.
I saw your p-site written in Chinese ok, so I took the liberty to ask for an article in Chinese.

I'd like to make a picture of Haruyuki Masayuki's skin for the Blue Line.
https://upload.cc/i1/2022/02/05/BjDG1m.png
https://upload.cc/i1/2022/02/05/bGkl14.png

I really like this picture of yours, if possible to this style
https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/90299768

I hope the teacher will consider it!

Hello, I was wondering if you could draw me in a spider-man suit with my color palette (mostly using the colors dark purple and black).

Any pose where she is jumping with the sunset in the background would be amazing! I will leave those details up to you.

https://imgur.com/a/i9JtoXQ

Hi! I quickly fell in love with your work and would be honored if you'd do art of my vtuber character.

She is a game developer who recently has gotten trapped in her own games. She is always exhausted but tries her best to be cheerful anyway. The lights on her headphones and mask do light up different colors, like the chromas you see on gaming hardware. The game I am developing for her debut is a 2D platformer! I will leave the pose, background, and which outfit up to you. I would just like to smile when I see the piece!

I would like to use this for my streaming, promotions, and merchandise (commercial use) for selling.

Aspect ratio: I'd prefer 21:9 but 16:9 is also good
DPI: 300dpi
I'd appreciate receiving the PSD or the character also as a transparent. You will always be credited. Thank you so much.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VqiIFziMlBgyoFHhiGPa20bu7fjwcF2g/view?usp=sharing

I love your art. I'd like to make it the background on my computer. Would you draw my character in a spider-man suit? No mask, please.
A costume like these https://twitter.com/CoralClownfish/ status / 1466777117304274955 

You do not need to draw the tail! You can change the hairstyle!

https://twitter.com/CoralClownfish/status/1466779132466024457

Hello, my name is Jezebel. I'm an ENvtuber who is a magician's assistant and I absolutely adore the artwork! I'd love to get art from you!

Character reference: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uMtp1MQK7PaIB1kbEs9ycR7b5Re_XVsn/view?usp=sharing (please use her first/main outfit!)

I'd like to request my character happily performing a trick on a magician's stage, with a galaxy and flowers/magic for the background, something like these: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kr3vqOpT0P-U-7itFDA_x5z_U7y3iOvX?usp=sharing

Her signature flowers are crocus and wisteria, but happy for other flowers to be included as well!

I would like to use this for streaming , thumbnails, twitter schedules and merchandise (commercial use) for selling.

Aspect ratio: 16:9
DPI: At least 300dpi
Can the character please be separate from the background!
Can I please also have the PSD file so I can use for transparent background.

Thank you!

Hello again! I loved the art you did for me. Thank you so much!

Name -  Hoshi Fumiko
Occupation - Dead Space Gardener
Aspect Ratio - 16:9
Reference - Please do an art with lots of balloons! I love bright and fun colors. Ideas for Balloons (https://imgur.com/a/U4Q0DXy)

The artwork will be used on SNS, Twitch, and possibly YouTube for thumbnails. The artwork will also be used for merchandise for selling. If possible, could I please have the PSD version that would allow for a transparent background? The artwork will always be credited.

Hello! I love your artwork!

I'm a vtuber debuting on June 12th. My name is Fumiko Hoshi and I'm a space gardener. I am also dead.

Please have her surrounded in a garden full of colorful roses, flowers, and trees. The background is a starry, sparkly sky.

Please use 16:9 aspect ratio. The artwork will be used on SNS, Twitch, and possibly YouTube for thumbnails. If possible, could I please have the PSD version that would allow for a transparent background? The artwork will always be credited.

Hello I love your art!  Please draw my character:
https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1F22lBmvXqYlAhsFyylVMtV3GLOx4J-CH

She is a polar bear inspired by the norther lights. She's very energetic and playful. She loves to eat, sleep, and dress up. I really wanted to request you as soon as I saw your drawings, but I'm not sure what to ask for so I will leave the choice up to you! You can draw any outfit or create one. Draw freely!

If you accept, please know I might use this piece on Twitter, Twitch, or Youtube with credit to you. Thank you for your time!

Hello!! Your art is so beautiful! Could I have a landscape illustration of my VTuber Onsta? She's a cheerful space traveler. I'd love for her to be looking up at the night sky with city lights in the background. I'd also like for her to have a hopeful expression! Thank you so much!

https://toyhou.se/9064359.onsta/gallery

Hello!
Can you draw my character in a elegant style like this one? Clothes design of your choice. No tattoos and with backgroud please. Thank you!

https://twitter.com/Aono_99/status/1392409291139608581/photo/1

https://imgur.com/a/5VkFx13

Hello! My name is Shirara. I am a ENVtuber who will be releasing a song cover for YouTube soon. The song will be "The Weight of The World" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gEgL-3gfexo . I will need the illustration in a 16:9 aspect ratio.

I would like my character to be softly crying and standing alone on top of reflective water during the night. There can be floating lanterns around her. 

Thank you so much!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_wItT5xJMQGBgnAtKJ4_nOyS5MBMjHA-/view?usp=sharing

Hello Aono, I saw your art for Roselia and I just feel in love with your art style! I am a pre-debut English Vtuber/Vstreamer and I will be using the illustration for Starting screen and Ending screen. 
I would like for you to draw my model looking back and reaching my hands out. I do not have an sketch of the back of my model so you could either draw my back or you could do the front side, either way is fine for me :)  . For the expression, I would like to have a joyful, cheerful expression. As for the background, I would like to have a walk/pathway in the middle with sakura trees and snow around the area. If possible, I would like for my model to be wearing a winter clothing. I'm not sure what else I would add so if you want to improve or add anything, please feel free to! 
Thank you so much!

Hello, it's nice to meet you! 
My request is for the character Claudette from the anime Queen's Blade (this is her design https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/queensblade/images/b/b7/94130cfe026ae5fbc9379af70e44984e.png). I would like her to be in this outfit (https://gbf.wiki/images/6/6c/Npc_zoom_3040245000_81.png). I know the clothing is complicated, so feel free to simplify it if needed.
If possible, please draw her standing in a storm, with a lot of lightning. Please put lightning on her sword too.
For the pose, please do a powerful pose like this (https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/e/e1/Nightmare03.png/220px-Nightmare03.png).

Thank you so much!

Hello Aono, I really like your art.
I'm a pre-debut English/French VTuber and I'm planning a song cover. The song I'm going to sing is You by Yuduki from Higurashi no naku Koro ni https://youtu.be/AqyKkcwd-rY , as it's going to be used on YouTube, please use a 16:9 size. 
I would like you to draw an illustration of my VTuber character for my song cover. If possible, please draw her in a white summer dress, you're free to do what you want for the hairstyle and the design of the dress. I want her to be alone, holding an umbrella while gazing at the sky.
If possible, I would really like it to be finished at the end of March or before, if not possible, I'm also OK with the start of April. 
Those are my requirement, you're free to do whatever you want for the rest.

Also, I would be really grateful if you could separate the background and the character layers in a psd file.

Thank you!

https://twitter.com/ozoraroselia/status/1355572867396677632?s=09

Hi! I am covering a song and wanted you to draw my persona for the cover! The song is https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rk38OJGBd3

https://toyhou.se/3557360.eili-persona-

Hello!
Can you please draw my character ?
Wearing this outfit :
https://toyhou.se/5796760.maud/6174617.autumn-party#20287414
Thank you!!

https://toyhou.se/5796760.maud

Hair color is pink. Uncomfortable long. Bears with dead eyes and gray eyes. The pupil is spiral. Bandage on both hands from the upper arm to the back of the hand. I have a rosary on my chest. I am sick in a dark atmosphere overall. He wears a black collar. Draw a nun with a big breast. I am happy if there are line drawings and rough sketches in the PSD.
